includedPullRequests.title: Fix spelling in five English source strings the app shows
includedPullRequests.body:
## What
Corrects five misspelled English source strings that are visible in the app, and renames their keys in `Localizable.xcstrings` so the lookups still match:

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| Savatzky-Golay | Savitzky-Golay |
| the algothim's result | the algorithm's result |
| typically be adressed | typically be addressed |
| injesting … quanitity | ingesting … quantity |
| Setup & Configuraton | Setup & Configuration |

## Why
These are user-facing typos in the source language; translators copy them into other languages (several translations of the smoothing explanation currently say "Savatzky").

## Notes
- The existing translations of the five strings are carried over to the renamed keys in the catalog, so nothing is lost in the app. Crowdin will see the renamed keys as new source strings, so its stored translations for the old keys will need to be re-linked or re-approved there.
- Translations themselves are not touched; those remain Crowdin's.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

includedPullRequests.title: Run the macOS jobs and unit tests on the xcode-27 runners
includedPullRequests.body:
All macOS jobs, the browser build (Validate Secrets, Add Identifiers, Create Certificates, Build Trio) and the unit tests, now run on the xcode-27 runner image with Xcode 27.0 selected explicitly. Builds on macos-26 have been waiting a long time for a runner and some fail; Loop and LoopFollow have already moved to xcode-27. Built from this branch in my fork, with every macOS job getting a runner within seconds and the build finishing in 26 minutes: https://github.com/bjorkert/Trio/actions/runs/45029349440

The unit tests use the iPhone 17 simulator on iOS 27.0 and get new cache keys so nothing built with Xcode 26.2 is restored. The simulator boots while the app builds, since its first boot on the xcode-27 image takes several minutes and otherwise pushes the test run past the test runner timeout. The algorithm package excludes the string catalog, because SwiftPM in Xcode 27 generates string symbols for it and fails on keys that differ only in case or punctuation; the algorithm reads its strings from the main bundle. Unit tests passed twice in my fork on a branch where the tests run on push: https://github.com/bjorkert/Trio/actions/runs/45051149766

includedPullRequests.title: chore: migrate to xcode folder
includedPullRequests.body:
(re-open #1563)

This PR migrates Trio from Groups to Folders.
Also delete unused files in order to make the migration complete.

Tested both iOS app and Watch app before submitting PR

Benefits of using Folders instead of Groups:

- The project.pbxproj is much smaller now (6910 lines -> 1733 lines)
  - Not all files and groups are defined in the file, the project structure is defined in your folder structure
  - Less merge conflicts in this file or random line changes
- If you delete a file in Xcode, you will also delete it in XCode
  - This will prevent zombi code from existing

Also fixes #1800

includedPullRequests.title: Let blacklist entries target a branch and commit SHA
includedPullRequests.body:
Allow blacklisted-versions.json to carry optional
`branch` and `sha` fields. An entry matches when its version matches
and, if given, the build's branch and commit (prefix match, 7+ chars,
case-insensitive) from BuildDetails.plist also match.

Earlier builds keep working: their decoder ignores unknown keys and
matches on `version` alone, so `version` stays required on every entry.
The cache is now also keyed on the commit SHA, and a malformed entry is
skipped rather than discarding the whole list.

Adds AppVersionCheckerTests, including a copy of the decoder from
earlier builds run against the new format and the published JSON file.

includedPullRequests.title: Fix IOB rounding and unify IOB formatting
includedPullRequests.body:
Unify IOB formatting so insulin on board shows the same way on every screen while following the user's locale.

- IOB slightly below zero, like -0.004, showed "-0 U", now it shows "0 U"
- Halves round away from zero like glucose and percent, so 0.125 shows "0.13" instead of "0.12"
- Contact image and calendar show up to two decimals, to be consistent with rest of IOB displays
- VoiceOver reads the Home IOB unit as "units" instead of the letter "U"
- Added tests for decimals, rounding and negative zero

Translation keys are unchanged.

For Live Activity consistency I will follow up in separate PR once I post other unifications for carbs/COB, TDD and durations.

includedPullRequests.title: Fix 12/24h time formatting and unify date and time formatting
includedPullRequests.body:
This fixes times not following the user's 12/24h setting. The manual 12/24h checks and the DateFormatters created in each screen are replaced with two shared styles, `.timeOfDay` and `.dateAndTime`.

- 12h/24h was detected by looking for "AM"/"PM" in a formatted time, so 12h users in locales that don't use "AM"/"PM" for example "pm", got 24h times in the override SMB schedule
- When the SMB schedule had the same start and end hour, it showed only "SMBs Off", so it looked like SMBs were off all day. But `DosingEngine` turns them off only for that hour, so now it shows it, for example "SMBs Off 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM"
- Stats hour ranges were always 24h ("23:00-24:00"), now they follow the locale
- Times use one format now, before some screens showed "6:07" and others "06:07"
- Removed duplicate and unused date formatters
- Numeric dates now show the full year
- Added tests

This fixes times not following the user's 12/24h setting. The manual 12/24h checks and the DateFormatters created in each screen are replaced with two shared styles, `.timeOfDay` and `.dateAndTime`.

- When the SMB schedule had the same start and end hour, it showed only "SMBs Off", so it looked like SMBs were off all day. But `DosingEngine` turns them off only for that hour, so now it shows it, for example "SMBs Off 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM"
- Stats hour ranges were always 24h ("23:00-24:00"), now they follow the locale
- Times use one format now, before some screens showed "6:07" and others "06:07"

- Numeric dates now show the full year
